title: Courtyard House
notes: Concept reconstruction, not a survey or construction model. Coordinates follow the drawing: +X right, +Z down the plan, +Y up. Levels are relative to ground finished floor.
Sections confirm grade −0.45 m, ground ±0.00 m, mansard finished floor +3.15 m (structure +3.02 m), ridge +8.14 m. Plan dimensions of 1000 and 1320 are interpreted as 10.00 and 13.20 m.

The stepped footprint and annex use the plan chains. Wall centrelines, opening offsets, partitions, stair flights and pergola members are traced or inferred; review the entrance, landings and jambs in cutaway.

Front entrance: three 15 cm rises from finished grade to the porch (pp. 1, 6). Garage to house: two 15 cm rises, 30 cm going (p. 1). The return stair has 19 equal rises between finished floors; its turn landing is the ninth rise. Ground-floor finished ceilings follow the 2.705 m section datum with an opening for both flights.

Pages 2, 4 and 5 show sloping linings and a suspended ceiling at about 2.86 m above the mansard floor. At the master dormer the lining meets the window head (+2.30 m above floor) at the inside wall face, as in B–B. Rooflight reveals follow the section A–A profile: plumb at the lower end, turning into a level return uphill. The bathroom uses this representative detail; sash dimensions and head return lengths are illustrative, not shop drawings.

Door swings are read from the plan arcs. The annex-to-house handing and garage lift are schematic; verify them before furniture procurement. The garage panel parks overhead without modelling tracks. Window joinery, dormer cheeks and stair details are illustrative. Terrace falls, landscaping and services are not fully reconstructed.

At the shared annex wall, the plaster gable follows the inside wall face up to the pitches (pp. 1, 4, 7); the exposed west gable remains timber. The four dormers have a nominal 25 mm outward cladding build-up with folded edge returns; exact flashing is inferred (pp. 3, 5–9). The ground floorboards end at the top surface; the exposed thin deck edge continues the plinth.

Carport: page 1 shows a 2.50 × 3.00 m store block, two 0.90 × 2.20 m doors on adjacent elevations, a 0.50 m sidelight to the technical room and 0.15 m thresholds. Divider and wall thicknesses are traced, not surveyed. The 9.00 × 7.95 m roof and PV follow p. 3; pp. 6–9 show +2.10 m eaves underside, +4.60 m ridge and open timber-slatted gables. Roof build-up, beam sections, slat spacing, ceiling and joinery are concept approximations, not structural or fire-door specifications.
Published built areas: ground 139.2 m², mansard 101.4 m², annex 49.8 m², carport 50.0 m². These are source annotations, not measured areas of the cutaway model.
